tools.name: show_project
tools.description: Project summary: aspect ratio, duration, tracks with item counts, media count, revision.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

tools.name: rename_project

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

tools.name: print_timeline
tools.description: Print the timeline as its literal TSX projection (header with media table, pending count and rev, then <track> and item elements, one per line). Always print before editing; use from/lines to read part of a long timeline.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

tools.name: check_timeline
tools.description: Check an edited timeline text without applying it: parse errors with positions, what would change, conflicts with edits made meanwhile.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

prefer.description: On conflicting edits keep the `file` (default) or `editor` value

tools.name: apply_timeline
tools.description: Apply an edit to the timeline as one undoable revision. Give `edits` (each oldText must occur exactly once in the printed timeline of `rev`; newText replaces it; empty newText deletes) with the `rev` from the header you edited, or a whole replacement `source`. Edits the person made meanwhile are merged. Returns what changed, conflicts and warnings, or the diagnostics that refused the edit.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: The rev from the printed header the edits were made against

edits.description: Text edits against the printed timeline

source.description: Complete replacement projection text (instead of edits)

prefer.description: Which side wins a conflict with edits the person made meanwhile (default file)

tools.name: verify_timeline
tools.description: Report problems: overlapping items, gaps on the main track, clips running past their source, missing or offline media, pending placeholders.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

tools.name: timeline_history
tools.description: List revisions (oldest first) with their source and summary.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

tools.name: undo_timeline
tools.description: Undo your most recent change that is not undone yet (or your revision `rev`) as a new revision. Only your own changes are undone; edits the person or other agents made meanwhile stay. Refused with undo.conflict, listing the items, when a later change touched the same fields.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: One of your revisions to undo (default: your latest)
